描述_EN: silver objects became important luxury items for emperors and high-ranking officials during the tang dynasty (ad 618-960), but silver could also be used to enhance the appearance of objects. the animal and vine designs were popular motifs in the metalwork production of the silk road during the tang dynasty, and the granulation technique was frequently executed on silver products. in this eight-lobed bronze mirror, the back is covered with an elaborate embossed and chased silver decoration.
描述_ZN: 银器在唐代（公元618-960年）成为皇帝和高级官员的重要奢侈品，但银也可以用来增强物品的外观。 在唐代丝绸之路的金属制品生产中，动物和藤蔓图案是很受欢迎的图案，颗粒技术也经常在银制品上执行。 在这面八叶铜镜中，背面布满了精致的浮雕和鏤空银饰。
